claim: Starting July 15, 2025, new AWS customers receive up to $200 in AWS Free Tier credits that can be applied towards eligible AWS services, including Amazon API Gateway; at account sign-up they can choose between a free plan and a paid plan, and the free plan is available for 6 months after account creation.

evidence.quote: Starting July 15, 2025, new AWS customers will receive up to $200 in AWS Free Tier credits, which can be applied towards eligible AWS services, including Amazon API Gateway. At account sign-up, you can choose between a free plan and a paid plan. The free plan will be available for 6 months after account creation.
